props.name: intervals
props.description: Oldest first. Each carries a measured `uptime`, a declared `status`, or both.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name — which service this describes.

props.name: from
props.description: Caption at the left-hand end of the strip.

props.name: to
props.description: Caption at the right-hand end of the strip.

props.name: degraded
props.description: Below this counts as degraded; below `down` counts as an outage. Ignored where a status is declared.

props.name: down
props.description: Ratio below which an interval counts as down. Ignored where a status is declared.

props.name: uptime
props.description: Uptime to print, 0 to 1. Averaged from the measured intervals when omitted.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Show the status key under the strip — once under a stack of strips is enough.

props.name: height
props.description: Bar height in pixels. Widths are flexible.
